uutiset.t: MMG Faces Beefed Up EU Evidence Citing Concerns Over Anglo Deal
uutiset.s: China’s MMG Ltd. faces mounting European Union opposition to its planned $500 million Anglo American Plc deal in Brazil, after EU watchdogs pointed to fresh evidence of the threat to future supplies of vital ferro nickel to the bloc’s stainless-steel industry.

uutiset.t: Lagarde Warns Europe is Too Hesitant Responding to Crises
uutiset.s: Outgoing ECB President Christine Lagarde in her final speech to the European Banking Congress urges policymakers to tackle risks before they materialize. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: AI Trade Unravels; Anthropic Drops After Strong Debut
uutiset.s: Global stocks hit their longest losing streak in more than three years. Anthropic falls in premarket trading after a blockbuster IPO as the selloff spreads across AI stocks. Katrina Dudley of Franklin Templeton joins "Bloomberg Brief" to discuss what's next for the AI trade. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Nvidia Turmoil Leaves Few Stock Market Winners in Sea of Losers
uutiset.s: After the chaos of the past week, the winners and losers from Jensen Huang’s stunning ouster from Nvidia Corp. are coming into focus.

uutiset.t: Gold’s Rout Tests the Myth of an All-Weather Safe Haven
uutiset.s: Bullion’s worst year in more than a decade shows why investors can’t count on it to protect against every kind of market turmoil.

uutiset.t: Price Hikes Set to Lift Materials Companies’ Margins in 2027
uutiset.s: Makers of steel, paint and packaging are expected to bounce back from a quarter of disappointing margins, with price increases and cost cuts set to lift profitability to its highest in almost three decades.

uutiset.t: Stock Rout’s Spread Beyond Tech Carries Warning From Dotcom-Era
uutiset.s: The way this AI-driven rout is spreading across stocks reveals some worrying similarities to market patterns leading up to the dotcom crash.

uutiset.t: Skepticism About AI Is Crushing Stock Prices Around the World
uutiset.s: Metals are slumping too as traders worry that demand will dry up.

uutiset.t: China’s Offshore Tax Clampdown Pushes Budget Into Rare Surplus
uutiset.s: China’s budget swung into a rare surplus in October, as tighter scrutiny of offshore wealth produced a one-off bonanza of individual income tax receipts and offset a long-awaited increase in fiscal spending.

uutiset.t: India’s Torrent Power Plans Third Rupee Bond Sale This Year
uutiset.s: Torrent Power Ltd., one of India’s largest private electricity utilities, is preparing to raise as much as 20 billion rupees ($215 million) through the sale of rupee-denominated bonds as early as next week, in what would be its third debt offering this year, according to people familiar with the mat

uutiset.t: JPMorgan’s Katrina Dudley Sees Opportunities Beyond Big Tech
uutiset.s: Katrina Dudley of J.P. Morgan Asset Management discusses opportunities beyond the biggest AI and tech names as the market broadens. uutiset.t: Europe Cocoa Fetches Big Premium to New York Ahead of New Rules
uutiset.s: London cocoa futures are commanding a widening premium over New York as the European Union’s impending deforestation rules threaten to tighten bean supplies to the bloc.

uutiset.t: Ivory Coast to Raise Mineral-Royalty Rates Before IMF Talks
uutiset.s: Ivory Coast plans to raise royalties paid by mining companies to boost government revenue before potential talks with the International Monetary Fund on a new financing program.

uutiset.t: CATL, Luxshare to Join Hong Kong Tech Index in Major Revamp
uutiset.s: Contemporary Amperex Technology Co. Ltd., Luxshare Precision Industry Co. and ASMPT Ltd. are among the stocks that will be added to Hong Kong’s Hang Seng Tech Index in a major expansion to better reflect China’s vast technology sector.

uutiset.t: Saudis Make Deal With Japan to Replenish Depleted Oil Stocks
uutiset.s: Saudi Arabia reached an agreement to help replenish Japan’s depleted crude stockpiles and expand the kingdom’s own storage capacity in the Asian country.
